review.name: Decision Review
review.for: A decision with a date: whether to launch a first builder cohort, change a programme that already runs, or hire someone to own it.
deliverables: A map of who is involved and who owns what
One recommendation with a named owner
A decision session with the person who approves the spend
review.continuation: Continuing into a Programme Build costs €28,000.
review.bookingIntro: You’re considering a 4-week Decision Review. We’ll use this 30-minute call to understand the decision, its date and who approves it, and whether the Review fits. If it isn’t the right fit, we’ll say so.

build.name: Programme Build
build.priceType: Fixed fee, with one stop gate
build.billing: €14,000 at kickoff; after the week-4 stop gate, €28,000 invoiced as €14,000 at week 5 and €14,000 at week 10.

phases.name: Decision Review
phases.text: We interview 8–10 people across your team, builders and partners, and decide with you what to change.

phases.name: Stop or continue
phases.text: Stop here and keep the decision, or continue.

phases.name: Design, launch, initial use and handover
phases.text: We design it and launch it with your team, watch how it is used, adjust it once and hand it over.

build.for: One change with a launch date: a path to a first useful build, a first builder cohort, a route for integrations, or a change to a programme that already runs.
build.bookingIntro: You’re considering a 13-week Programme Build. We’ll use this 30-minute call to understand the programme, its launch date and who would run it, and whether the Build fits. If it isn’t the right fit, we’ll say so.

excluded: Software builds beyond configuring existing tools, ongoing operation, events, paid media, travel and third-party costs.
